newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong's Shui On says IPO 14 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's Shui On says IPO 14 times subscribed.

text.p: Shui On Construction and Materials Ltd said on Wednesday its initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong was 14.03 times subscribed.

The company said in a statement it had received applications for a total 205.17 million shares compared with 14.63 million shares available for public subscription. Another 1.62 million shares reserved for employee were fully allotted.
Trading in the stock is due to begin on Monday.
Shui On Construction, a unit of the Shui On group, offered 65 million shares at HK$9.30 per share in a Hong Kong IPO.
Of the total, 48.75 million shares were for professional investors in Asia and Europe and the remaining 16.25 million shares for public subscription in Hong Kong.
The company said it would use the proceeds of the offering to expand its construction material operations in China with the balance for general working capital.

Shui On Construction supplies ready-mixed concrete, rock products, cement and ready-mixed mortars throughout Hong Kong and Southern China. It is also involved in the construction of public housing and institutional buildings.
